details: Tensions between the United States and Iran continue to escalate, with reports of a recent ceasefire breakdown. This ongoing conflict is significantly impacting global financial markets, leading to increased volatility in oil prices, gold, currencies, and equities. Investors are reacting to the heightened geopolitical risks and the potential for further disruptions to critical economic routes.
title: Ongoing US-Iran Conflict Escalates, Fueling Market Uncertainty

details: Russia's State Duma has passed a bill establishing a full legal framework for cryptocurrency circulation, set to take effect on September 1, 2026. The new law introduces licensing procedures for crypto exchanges, brokers, custodians, and other market participants, with oversight from the Bank of Russia. It aims to create a regulated crypto market, enhancing transparency and investor protection.
title: Russia Legalizes Cryptocurrency, Implements Regulatory Framework

details: Vietnam has implemented new regulatory penalties for cryptocurrency-related activities, which will come into effect on September 1, 2026. The penalties include maximum fines of up to 200 million Vietnamese dong (approximately $7,700). This move signifies a tightening of regulatory oversight in the country's crypto sector.
title: Vietnam Introduces New Crypto Regulatory Penalties

details: Tether Gold (XAUT) has been officially recognized by the Abu Dhabi Global Market (ADGM) as an "accepted spot commodity." This recognition allows Tether Gold to be eligible for various financial services within the ADGM jurisdiction, marking a significant step towards institutional adoption and regulatory clarity for gold-backed stablecoins.
title: Tether Gold Recognized as Accepted Spot Commodity in Abu Dhabi

details: Despite ongoing geopolitical risks and broader market cautiousness, Bitcoin has shown resilience, finding support around $64,000 and extending gains above $65,000. Ethereum is also attracting significant inflows into its spot ETFs, indicating a renewed wave of optimism and increasing institutional participation in the digital asset market. Investors are showing confidence in risk assets, driven by improving macroeconomic conditions.
title: Bitcoin and Ethereum Show Resilience Amid Market Volatility
